description: Retrieves the 'starting at' price for moving labor services in a specific United States ZIP code. The returned price is a flat estimated starting total for the stated hours and crew size, not an hourly rate. Do NOT divide it by hours or by crew to derive a per-hour rate. For the true per-hour figure (extraHourRate) and a full pricing breakdown, call list_service_providers with resultFormat=Full.
name: get_starting_price
